name: Cheryl Shaw Williams
office: Inglewood Unified School District, Member, Board of Education, Trustee Area 1

items.text: Cheryl Shaw Williams is an insurance professional and Inglewood planning commissioner running for school board. She graduated from Morningside High School and earned a sociology degree from California State University, Dominguez Hills. She helped establish the Morningside Monarchs Alumni Association and serves on a scholarship board for the Inglewood Century Heights Neighborhood Watch Association.

items.text: Williams says her priorities include fiscal responsibility, academic excellence, safe learning environments, transparency, expanded tutoring and literacy programs, STEM and career technical education, arts education, after-school programs, and student mental health services.
